BALOCHISTAN
F1NANCE AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVI
OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan
Finance Ordinance,
1969
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
20th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2-42/Law/79/IV; dated
20-10-2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
15th October, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
1. Short title and commencement.---(1) This Ordinance may
be called the Balochistan Finance (Amendment) Ordinance, 2001.
(2) It shall come into force at
once

Amendment of section 8 of Ordinance VII of 1969

ORDINANCE XXXVI OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN
F1NANCE AMENDMENT ORDINANCE, 2001
ORDINANCE XXXVI
OF 2001
An Ordinance further to amend the Balochistan
Finance Ordinance,
1969
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
20th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2-42/Law/79/IV; dated
20-10-2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor of Balochistan on
15th October, 2001, is hereby published for general information:--
2. Amendment of section 8 of
Ordinance VII of 1969.---In the Balochistan Finance Ordinance, 1969, in
clause (i) of subsection (1) of section 8, for the words "Twenty five
paisa per ticket" the words "Thirteen paisa per ticket" shall be
substituted.
